items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee responds politely to the interviewer but no personal relationship is described.

ctx.x: Leo was interviewed in Clinton, NY on March 23, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are on the Hamilton College campus for the Jazz Archive, filming today. And I’m very pleased to have Mr. Leo Rayhill, Class of ’49, as my guest.
I’m delighted to be here. You’ve done such a wonderful job with the Archives, it’s unreal.
